# Eco Appliance Services

> Appliance repair and duct/dryer-vent cleaning for homes across Washington DC, Maryland and Northern Virginia (the DMV). Licensed technicians, upfront pricing, $89 diagnostic credited toward the repair, home-warranty claims accepted.

- Website: https://www.eco-applianceservices.com/
- Phone: (571) 462-1813
- Hours: Mon-Sat 8:00am-7:00pm, Sunday emergency dispatch

## Services
- Refrigerator, washer, dryer, dishwasher, cooktop and range repair
- Dryer vent cleaning and air duct cleaning
- Home warranty service (American Home Shield, Choice, First American and others)
